hypothesis: Temporal drift is component-specific; selectively decaying only the O6-supported components may improve out-of-sample ODI probabilities without discarding stable bowling-rate information.
change: Replace only the five O6-supported components with exponentially recency-weighted historical aggregates using fixed per-match decay factor 2^(-1/20). Strength is recomputed from the resulting six matchup metrics; no independent extra feature column is added.
decision_rule: Promote O7 only if the calibrated improvement is credible on the frozen baseline test and remains supported by rolling-origin and independent future-holdout evidence.
